# Weather — Operations Dashboard

Technical and business telemetry for the Weather single host.

**Placeholders:** replace `{{AppInsightsResourceId}}` with the Application Insights resource id before import.

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(1h) | summarize Rate = count(), Failures = countif(success == false), ErrorRate = todouble(countif(success == false)) / count() * 100 by bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Availability — requests, failures, error rate (1h)

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(1h) | summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by name | order by p95 desc
content.title: Latency — p50/p95/p99 by route

content.query: dependencies | where timestamp > ago(1h) and target contains 'openweathermap' | summarize Calls = count(), Failures = countif(success == false), FailureRate = todouble(countif(success == false)) / count() * 100 by bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: OpenWeatherMap dependency — calls and failure rate

content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(1h) and name startswith 'dotnet.' | summarize avg(valueSum) by name, bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Runtime — dotnet.* GC / thread-pool / process

content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(24h) and name == 'weather.report.requests' | extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions['weather.outcome']) | summarize Requests = sum(valueSum) by outcome, bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Business — weather lookups by outcome (24h)

content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(24h) and name in ('favorites.operations', 'notes.operations') | extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions[iff(name == 'favorites.operations', 'favorites.outcome', 'notes.outcome')]) | summarize Operations = sum(valueSum) by name, outcome, bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Business — favorites & notes funnels (24h)

content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(24h) and name in ('favorites.saved.count', 'notes.saved.count') | summarize Value = max(valueMax) by name, bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Business KPIs — saved favorites and notes

content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(24h) and name startswith 'integration.event.' | extend eventType = tostring(customDimensions['event.type']) | summarize Events = sum(valueSum) by name, eventType | order by Events desc
content.title: Integration events — published / handled / failed

content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp > ago(24h) and name == 'api.errors' | extend code = tostring(customDimensions['error.code']) | summarize Errors = sum(valueSum) by code, bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Errors — api.errors by stable code (24h)
